records.title: Delay in Construction of AIIMS, Madurai
details: a to c: establishment of All India Institute of Medical Science (AIIMS) Madurai has been approved at a cost of Rs. 2021.51 crore.

records.title: Upgradation of ESI Dispensaries in Vellore Lok Sabha Constituency
details: Part (a) to (d) : ESI Corporation has given in-principle approval for setting up of 100-bedded ESI hospital at Vaniyambadi in Tirupattur district of Vellore Parliamentary constituency, Tamil Nadu.
